title: Card on file validation result received
description: Card on file validation event. The Create card on file, Submit validation try and Create card validation endpoints generate this event. If the validation fails, an exclusion-1 event is generated.

creation_date.title: Creation date
creation_date.description: Card creation date/time in RFC3339 format, i.e., 2019-07-03T17:23:18Z,

issuer_card.title: Card issuer flag.
issuer_card.description: Is card issued by this issuer flag.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Metadata added when card on file created. Client-created - no business rule validation is done.

verification_start_date.title: Verification start date
verification_start_date.description: Verification start date/time  RFC3339 format, i.e., 2019-07-03T17:23:18Z
